description: Role-aware grammar for scripts/ with 3 role families + unclassified

runnable_entrypoint.description: Has __main__ guard; callable directly as a CLI script
runnable_entrypoint.adversarial_note: Text search for 'if __name__' matches inside string literals and comments. AST restricts detection to actual module-level If nodes — the only robust approach.
runnable_entrypoint.v1_policy: Both canonical (`if __name__ == '__main__':`) and reversed (`if '__main__' == __name__:`) comparison forms are recognized. AST normalization checks both orderings of the equality — neither form is rejected silently.

import_safe_support.description: Importable library; no top-level side effects; provides reusable functions or classes
adversarial_notes: Bypass closed: sys.path.insert inside an if-guard is not a bare Expr(Call) and would be missed by bare-call detection alone; we scan all module-level control flow for sys.path mutations.

Bypass closed: Call-type decorators (@register(), @app.route('/')) on top-level function/class definitions execute at import time. Detected by scanning FunctionDef/AsyncFunctionDef/ClassDef.decorator_list for ast.Call nodes.
Known limitation: any 'import X' at module level may execute X's side effects at import time; detecting this requires knowing X's implementation — not statically possible.

declaration_module.description: Primarily data (constants, tables, schemas); no behavior or control flow beyond TYPE_CHECKING imports
adversarial_notes: Bypass closed: a file with only named assignments could still contain an if-block with a non-import call body (conditional behavior). We reject any module-level ast.If whose body is not purely imports, except TYPE_CHECKING guards.

Known limitation (V1): assignments like X = os.getenv('VAR') contain a Call in the RHS but pass the data-body check. Tolerated in V1 because detecting side-effectful RHS expressions requires dataflow analysis; practical impact is low (RHS calls in this codebase are config reads). V2 path: side-effect-free callable allowlist or restrict to literal-only RHS values.

unclassified.description: Does not fit cleanly into any role family; always carries an explicit reason
unclassified.note: NOT a catch-all. Every unclassified result has a specific reason string documenting why no role applied.

has_ast_main_guard.implementation: ast.If at module.body level where test is ast.Compare(ast.Name('__name__'), ast.Eq(), ast.Constant('__main__'))
has_ast_main_guard.bypass_closed: Text search matches inside string literals; AST does not.

has_functions_or_classes.description: File contains at least one FunctionDef, AsyncFunctionDef, or ClassDef
has_functions_or_classes.implementation: ast.walk finds any of: ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef, ast.ClassDef

no_toplevel_bare_calls.description: No ast.Expr(ast.Call) directly in module.body (no calls made purely for side effects)
no_toplevel_bare_calls.implementation: module.body has no Expr nodes whose value is a Call

no_module_level_sys_path_mutation.description: No sys.path.insert/append/remove/pop anywhere in module-level code (excluding function/class bodies)
no_module_level_sys_path_mutation.implementation: ast.walk over module.body nodes (skipping FunctionDef/ClassDef bodies) finds no _is_sys_path_mutating_call matches
no_module_level_sys_path_mutation.bypass_closed: sys.path mutation inside an if-guard is not a bare call; bare-call check alone would miss it.

has_only_data_body.description: Module body contains only imports, assignments, string constants, and TYPE_CHECKING-guarded ifs
has_only_data_body.implementation: All module.body nodes are: Import | ImportFrom | Assign | AnnAssign | Expr(Constant) | If(TYPE_CHECKING) | If(imports-only body)
has_only_data_body.bypass_closed: Non-trivial If blocks with non-import bodies are rejected — catches config files with conditional behavior.

no_decorator_side_effects.description: No Call-type decorators on top-level function or class definitions
no_decorator_side_effects.implementation: Scan module.body for FunctionDef/AsyncFunctionDef/ClassDef nodes; check decorator_list for any ast.Call node
no_decorator_side_effects.bypass_closed: @register(), @app.route('/'), etc. execute at import time. Bare name decorators (@staticmethod, @property) are ast.Name/ast.Attribute, not ast.Call, and do not trigger this predicate.

inventory_policy.rationale: scripts/ already contains classifiable subdirectories (scripts/circle1/). A flat scan would silently skip these files, creating a gap between grammar coverage and inventory reporting. Recursive scanning is the correct V1 policy.
